body.p: This Listing of Claims will replace all prior versions and listings of claims in this application.

br.br:
1. (Currently Amended) A robot (100), comprising:
a first arm link (1011);
a hollow shaft (102) extending along a first axis (X1) thereof and coupled to the first arm link (1011);
a first stage reduction assembly (103) coupled to a power source {P-) of the robot (100);
and a second stage reduction assembly (104) comprising:
an input (1041) coupled to an output of the first stage reduction assembly (103) and adapted to rotate about a second axis (X2) offset from the first axis (X1); and
an output (1042) coaxially arranged on a periphery of the hollow shaft (102) and adapted to engage with the input (1041) to cause a rotation of the first arm link (1011) via the hollow shaft (102).
2. (Currently Amended) The robot (100) of claim 1, wherein the first stage reduction assembly (103) comprises a gearhead coupled to an output shaft of the power source P-
3. (Currently Amended) The robot (100) of claim 1, further comprising:
at least one bearing (105) arranged on the periphery of the hollow shaft (102).
4. (Currently Amended) The robot (100) of claim 1, further comprising:
a second arm link (1012) connected to the first arm link (1011) via the hollow shaft (102), and
wherein the hollow shaft (102) and the first and second stage reduction assemblies (103, 104) are partially arranged in one of the first and second arm links (1011, 1012).
5. (Currently Amended) The robot (100) of claim 1, wherein the second stage reduction assembly (104) further comprises a belt (1043) via which the input (1041) and the output (1042) engage with each other.
6. (Currently Amended) The robot (100) of claim 5, wherein the belt (1043) comprises a synchronous belt.
7. (Currently Amended) The robot (100) of claim 1, wherein the input (1041) and the output (1042) comprise spur gears or bevel gears.
8. (Currently Amended) The robot (100) of claim 1, wherein the hollow shaft (102) is coupled to the first arm link (1011) via a keyway structure or screws, or the hollow shaft (102) and the first arm link (1011) are integrally formed.
9. (Currently Amended) The robot (100) of claim 1, the hollow shaft (102) and the output component (1042) are integrally formed or assembled by interference fit or screw pressing.
10. (Currently Amended) An assembly method of a robot (100), comprising:
providing a first arm link (1011);
providing a hollow shaft (102) extending along a first axis (X1) and coupled to the first arm link (1011);
providing a first stage reduction assembly (103) coupled to a power source {P-}; and
providing a second stage reduction assembly (104) comprising:
an input (1041) coupled to an output of the first stage reduction assembly (103) to rotate about a second axis (X2) offset from the first axis (X1); and
an output (1042) coaxially arranged on a periphery of the hollow shaft (102) and adapted to engage with the input (1041) to cause a rotation of the first arm link (1011) via the hollow shaft (102).
